sentences.text: Heard learned counsel for the petitioner and learned counsel for the State.

2. The Petitioner is an accused in connection with G.R case No. 796 of 2023, pending in the Court of learned S.D.J.M., Berhmapur arising out of Gosaninuagaon P.S. Case No. 113 of 2023, for alleged commission of offences under Sections 420/120- B/467/468 and 471 of the IPC.

3. Being aggrieved by the rejection of his application for bail U/s. 439 Cr.P.C. by the learned 3rd Additional Sessions Judge, Berhampur by order dated 18.05.2023 in the aforementioned case, the present BLAPL has been filed.
4. It is submitted by the learned counsel that the allegation against the petitioner is that he along with one Daitari Behera have been provided fake B. Ed certificates.
5. It is submitted by the learned counsel that the petitioner is in custody since 24.04.2023 and that the entire allegation is based on documentary evidence.
Since investigation has progressed substantially, he may be released on bail.

6. Learned counsel for the State opposes the prayer inter alia during currency of investigation and also drawing the attention to the Court to the fact that the petitioner has one antecedent of similar nature (i.e. Jeypore P.S. Case No. 287 of 2015).
7.

Considering the nature of allegation, role ascribed to the petitioner and the punishment prescribed, this Court directs the petitioner to be released on bail on such terms to be fixed by the Kishore Kumar Behera vs State Of Odisha ....

learned Court in seisin.

8. Additionally it is directed that, the petitioner shall appear before the jurisdictional police station once a week on such date and time to be fixed by the learned Court in seisin till submission of final form.
Certification of such appearance shall be submitted to the Court in seisin.
9. Before releasing the Petitioner on bail, learned Court in seisin shall verify as to whether the petitioner has any other criminal antecedent than the one noted above.
If it comes to the fore that he has any other antecedent, this order shall stand recalled.
10. Accordingly, the BLAPL stands disposed of.
11. Urgent certified copy of this order be granted as per rules.
